page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 959 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations position this server primarily in the average tier for multi-core and memory operations, though single-core performance is relatively weak. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance and single-threaded gzip compression both fall into the bottom 25% of tested servers. Conversely, multi-core performance metrics, such as the stress-ng multi-core test, Geekbench multi-core score, and PassMark CPU score, fall within the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks, along with PassMark memory scores, also align with average tier performance.

The server exhibits a clear tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution speeds, indicating that workloads relying heavily on single-threaded performance may experience bottlenecks. However, the inclusion of 959 GB of local SSD storage combined with average multi-threaded and database operation performance makes it a viable option for data-intensive tasks. This hardware profile is suitable for database operations, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks, offering a balanced resource density of memory and local storage without the added cost of GPU hardware.
